title: Kissed Silky Norwegian Salmon Biryani
description: A sweet and silky Norwegian dish featuring malai and salmon, perfect for meal prep, cooked to perfection in a bamboo steamer using a pressure cooker, and high in protein.
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice in a fine mesh sieve until the water runs clear, then soak it in water for 30 minutes.
Heat the ghee in a pan over medium heat and saute the cumin seeds until fragrant.
Add the sliced onion to the pan and cook until it is lightly browned.
In a large bowl, mix together the malai, salt, and cooked onion mixture.
Add the soaked and drained basmati rice to the bowl and mix well.
Cut the Norwegian salmon fillets into large pieces and add them to the bowl, gently folding them into the rice mixture.
Transfer the rice and salmon mixture to a bamboo steamer lined with parchment paper.
Place the bamboo steamer in a pressure cooker with 2 cups of water and cook for 10 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally, then open the lid and fluff the biryani with a fork.
Serve the Kissed Silky Norwegian Salmon Biryani hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
